key.name: source-language
key.description: The language of the text to translate. The special value 'auto' enables automatic detection.

key.name: target-language
key.description: The language to translate text into.

key.name: translate-while-typing
key.description: Start a translation after text stops changing for one second.

key.name: translation-cache-enabled
key.description: Keep successful translations in memory for reuse during this Shell session.

key.name: translation-cache-size
key.description: Maximum number of successful translations kept in memory. Zero disables caching.

key.name: open-shortcut
key.description: Keybinding that toggles the Langux translator popup.
